{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Sauces|Sauces]] | [[Cookbook:Texas cuisine|Texas cuisine]]

This is a simple barbecue [[Cookbook:Sauce|sauce]] that works well for everyday meals, even with leftover [[Cookbook:Meat|meat]] and picky eaters. It is best served with [[Cookbook:Soda Pop|soda]] and [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]], and perhaps also [[Cookbook:Steaming|steamed]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable|vegetables]].

The ideal meat to use would be thin slices of eye-of-round [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] roast. The sauce also goes well with [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]], [[Cookbook:Turkey|turkey]], and [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]].

== Ingredients ==
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (62.5 [[Cookbook:ML|mL]])  [[Cookbook:Sugar#Brown sugar|brown sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] (15 [[Cookbook:ML|mL]]) [[Cookbook:Garlic powder|garlic powder]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] (15 [[Cookbook:ML|mL]]) [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika powder]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] (10 [[Cookbook:ML|mL]]) [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 heaping [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] (6.66 [[Cookbook:ML|mL]]) of ground [[Cookbook:Coffee|coffee]] beans
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (250 [[Cookbook:ML|mL]]) [[Cookbook:Ketchup|ketchup]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (125 [[Cookbook:ML|mL]]) [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] (45 [[Cookbook:ML|mL]]) [[Cookbook:Vinegar#White vinegar|white vinegar]]
* A shot of [[Cookbook:Whiskey|whiskey]] or ½ shot of [[Cookbook:Cognac|cognac]]
* A squeeze of [[Cookbook:Lemon juice|lemon juice]]

== Procedure ==
#Mix everything in a pot.
#Let it [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for around 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
#You may optionally add 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] (5 [[Cookbook:ML|mL]]) of [[Cookbook:Onion powder|onion powder]], and/or aromatics (e.g. [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]] or [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]) to the sauce
#You may optionally add 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] (30 [[Cookbook:ML|mL]]) of [[Cookbook:Rice vinegar|rice vinegar]], but if you do, add only 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] (30 [[Cookbook:ML|mL]]) of [[Cookbook:Vinegar#White vinegar|white vinegar]]
